subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw support a session-owned multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and should that contract be unified with the one-turn Gateway/chat override work?
rationale: The request adds public command syntax, config surface, persisted session semantics, provider/auth routing behavior, and overlap with existing one-turn override proposals; automation should not choose those product/API rules.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define a maintainer-approved temporary model lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway/session fields against that single contract.

options.title: Settle one-turn overrides first
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100876 settle request-local override semantics before adding multi-turn leases.

options.title: Decline native leases
options.body: Do not add turn-limited model leases and document manual `/model default`, allowlists, or operational policy as the supported cost-governance path.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define a maintainer-approved temporary model lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway/session fields against that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the session model override, Gateway patch, directive parsing, and auth-profile semantics that would own the lease contract.
